ECG_PTB-XL_to_cardio_train.reason: PTB-XL waveform files (.hea, .dat) are ABSENT from the repository. Even if present, PTB-XL patient_ids and cardio_train.csv 'id' integers originate from entirely different cohorts (German ECG study vs. Russian hospital cardiovascular survey). No verified crosswalk exists.

ECG_PTB-XL_to_NBME_notes.reason: PTB-XL waveform files absent. PTB-XL uses German hospital patient cohort. NBME notes use US medical licensing examination synthetic/de-identified text. No shared patient identifier exists and no crosswalk is documented.

cardio_train_to_NBME_notes.reason: cardio_train.csv uses sequential integer IDs from a Russian cardiovascular survey. NBME patient notes use pn_num identifiers from a US medical licensing examination dataset. These represent completely different patient populations, countries, and data domains. No crosswalk, no shared identifier, no documented common source.

gat_node_design_if_data_existed.missing_modality: Would require explicit missing-modality policy — not evaluable without paired data

GAT_multimodal_fusion_feasibility.reason: No legitimate patient-level pairing exists across any two of the three datasets. PTB-XL waveform data is absent. NBME labels are clinical phrase spans, not cardiovascular diagnosis. cardio_train.csv has no shared identifier with either ECG or NLP dataset. Training a supervised multimodal GAT requires co-occurring same-patient records across all three modalities, which do not exist in this repository.
